THE ECHO BELOW · SCENE
After rescue · What Sildar knows
Change prepared scene
Say aloud

Once he can sit and breathe, Sildar looks toward the cave passage. “Gundren was taken away from here. They wanted him—and the map he carried.”

The passage is still close enough that a voice raised here could carry farther than intended. Sildar's words give you a name and an object to ask about, but not a destination. There is time to hear him out, check what help he needs, and decide where to take the conversation.

Ask the players

Let the players ask questions. Sildar answers what he knows and says clearly when he does not know.
